# DailyArt Magazine

> > DailyArt Magazine is an online art history publication featuring exhibition reviews, artist profiles, and educational content spanning from Renaissance masters like Leonardo da Vinci and Rembrandt to contemporary movements including Pop Art and Surrealism.

The magazine covers major museums worldwide including the Art Institute of Chicago, Musée d'Orsay, Tate, and Rijksmuseum, with particular focus on European art history. Content ranges from deep dives into art movements like Primitivism and Symbolism to profiles of iconic artists such as Vincent van Gogh, Pablo Picasso, and Claude Monet.

## Key Topics

- Art History
- Exhibition Reviews
- Museum Highlights
- Vincent van Gogh
- Leonardo da Vinci

## Art Movements & History

- [Everything You Need to Know About Primitivism](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/primitivism): Primitivism in Modernism: Picasso, Kirchner & tribal art influences
- [Painting of the Week: Masaccio, The Tribute Money](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/painting-of-the-week-masaccio-the-tribute-money): Masaccio's Tribute Money fresco from Brancacci Chapel analyzed
- [Paul Gauguin, The Yellow Christ](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/paul-gauguin-yellow-christ-painting-week): Gauguin's 1889 Yellow Christ painting from Pont-Aven at Albright-Knox Gallery
- [His Majesty Jan Van Eyck and the Optical Revolution - Review](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/his-majesty-jan-van-eyck-and-the-optical-revolution-review): Jan van Eyck exhibition review featuring Ghent Altarpiece restoration
- [Auguste Renoir - Two Young Girls at the Piano](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/auguste-renoir-two-young-girls-piano): Renoir's Two Young Girls at Piano commissioned for Musée du Luxembourg

## Exhibition Reviews

- [Groundbreaking Slavery Exhibition: Rijksmuseum](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/slavery-exhibition-rijksmuseum): Rijksmuseum Amsterdam slavery exhibition on Dutch colonial history
- [Alphonse Mucha: Art Nouveau Visionary](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/alphonse-mucha-art-nouveau-visionary): Mucha Art Nouveau exhibition at North Carolina Museum featuring Bernhardt
- [The Venice Biennale: 10 Best Pavilions in Giardini](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/the-venice-biennale-10-best-pavilions-in-giardini): Top 10 national pavilions at Venice Biennale's Giardini park
- [Seen 'The Shape of Time' Exhibition? Hurry Up, Time's Up](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/the-shape-of-time-exhibition): Kunsthistorisches Museum Vienna's Shape of Time exhibition review
- [Richard Saltoun Gallery: Bodily Objects - Review](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/bodily-objects-saltoun): Feminist art exhibition review: Slinger, English at Richard Saltoun Gallery

## Museum Highlights

- [The Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge Highlights](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/fitzwilliam-museum-highlights): Fitzwilliam Museum Cambridge reopening highlights featuring Veneziano & da Vinci
- [Rijksmuseum. A Filter of Beauty](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/rijksmuseum-a-filter-of-beauty): Personal reflection on Rijksmuseum Amsterdam museum experience

## Contemporary Art & Artists

- [Meet Jordan Wolfson's Alluring and Creepy Animatronic Sculptures](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/meet-jordan-wolfsons-alluring-and-creepy-animatronic-sculptures): Jordan Wolfson's animatronic sculptures exploring AI and high-tech art
- [The Storytelling Art of Kris Knight](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/the-storytelling-art-of-kris-knight): Canadian artist Kris Knight's narrative pastel portraits & androgynous subjects
- [Art of the Brick - Nathan Sawaya's Lego Works](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/nathan-sawayas-lego): Nathan Sawaya's contemporary Lego sculptures & Art of the Brick exhibition

## Artist Profiles & Stories

- [Dick Ket: The Artist with Drumstick Fingers](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/dick-ket-the-artist-with-drumstick-fingers): Dutch magic realist Dick Ket's self-portraits and medical condition
- [La Calavera Catrina. A Skeleton Lady](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/la-calavera-catrina-a-skeleton-lady): José Guadalupe Posada's Catrina skeleton & Mexican Day of the Dead art
- [Barbara Rose Legacy: NYC Art Critic](https://www.dailyartmagazine.com/barbara-rose): Barbara Rose's legacy as influential American art critic & historian

## Optional
